origin.summary: Workout 3 of the 2025 CrossFit Open. The Open is the worldwide online qualifying stage of the CrossFit Games season: one workout released each week, completed and scored by hundreds of thousands of athletes in affiliates and garages on the same few days.

description: A chipper repeating wall climbs before each of four different movements — rowing, a deadlift set, a clean set, and a snatch set — bookended by matching rowing pieces.
source_notes: games.crossfit.com/workouts/open/2025/3 (official CrossFit Games Open workout), retrieved 2026-07-09
